_comment: Transition validators workflow-apply.sh --rules ensures are present.
Additive only: a rule already on the transition (same ruleKey + parameters) is left alone, a missing one is appended, nothing is ever removed.
Transitions are matched by NAME. Parameter values may name a field or a status instead of a site id:
{field:<name>}  -> the custom field id, resolved via GET /field
{status:<name>} -> the status id, resolved via GET /statuses/search
Names are matched exactly and case-sensitively; a placeholder that resolves to zero or several matches is fatal.
Parameter shapes for both ruleKeys were recorded from live Jira Cloud responses: fixtures/workflows.bulkget.rules-after.txt.
Which work-order requirement each rule serves is stated in BINDING.md.

parameters.errorMessage: verify is required before work starts (work-order MUST-7)
touches is required before work starts (work-order MUST-13, tightened by JIRA-6)
verify is required before completing (work-order MUST-7)
outcome is required to cancel (work-order MUST-28)
